# Skills 42U — llms.txt

## About
Skills 42U delivers accredited, on-site first aid training courses for businesses across Kent and the South East. All courses are Ofqual-regulated and HSE-compliant.

## Contact
Phone: 07481 344486
Email: info@skills42u.com
Website: https://www.skills42u.com

## Services
- Emergency First Aid at Work (EFAW) — 6-hour course, £495 per group of up to 12 delegates
- Paediatric First Aid — 2-day course, £900 per group of up to 12 delegates
- First Aid at Work (Full) — 3-day course, £1,300 per group of up to 12 delegates

All courses are delivered at the client's premises. Certificates issued same day, valid for 3 years.

## Areas Served
Kent, Essex, London. Medway, Maidstone, Dartford, Ashford, Tunbridge Wells, Sittingbourne, Sevenoaks, Canterbury, Chelmsford, Basildon, Southend-on-Sea, Colchester, Harlow, Thurrock, Romford, Brentwood, Ilford, Barking, Dagenham, East London (Tower Hamlets, Newham, Hackney, Stratford, Canary Wharf, Waltham Forest, Redbridge, Havering), South London (Bromley, Croydon, Sutton, Merton, Wandsworth, Lambeth, Southwark, Lewisham, Greenwich, Bexley), North London (Enfield, Haringey, Barnet, Harrow), West London (Ealing, Hammersmith and Fulham, Hounslow, Brent, Hillingdon, Richmond upon Thames, Kingston upon Thames) and surrounding areas.
